shared_elements: upright slab/stela with rounded or arched top
vertical elongated forms that may read as standing figures in the upper field
justification: Both are upright, arch-topped stela-shaped fields, and B's faint vertical bulges could conceivably be read as standing figures like the paired figures under the rayed disc in A, which is the only correspondence of substance. But A shows a fully legible programme — a winged/rayed disc, flanking figures beneath it, and many ruled registers of dense script — whereas B shows no identifiable motif, no disc, no inscription and no discernible relationship between elements, so nothing specific links the two.
